Use the **AI assistance** panel for styling to understand a website's overall
layout, specific element styles and to get AI generated fixes for CSS bugs.

## Open the "AI assistance" panel

The **AI assistance** panel opens [in the drawer](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/console/reference#drawer).

![The AI assistance panel opened in its default state.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/open-default.png)

### From the Elements panel

To open **AI assistance** from the Elements panel, when
[inspecting a DOM node](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/dom#inspect),
right-click the node and select the **Ask AI** option.

![The element context menu with 'Ask AI' highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/styling/open-context-menu.png)

When you open **AI assistance** like this, the inspected DOM element is already
pre-selected as a context element for the conversation.

Alternatively, click the floating button attached to a hovered DOM node.

![The floating button attached to a DOM node.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/styling/open-floating-button.png)

> [!NOTE]
> **Note:** When opening **AI assistance** with the following methods, make sure to select [Conversation context](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/styling#conversation_context) as outlined above.

### From the command menu

To open **AI assistance** from the command menu, type `AI` and then run the
**Show AI assistance** command, which has the **Drawer** badge next to it.

![The opened ommand menu with 'Show AI assistance' highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/open-command-menu.png)

### From the "More tools" menu

Alternatively, in the top right corner, select **More options** \> **More tools** \> **AI assistance**.

![The opened more tools menu.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/open-more-tools.png)

## Conversation context

Chats with **AI assistance** always relate to the currently inspected element,
which is the last element selected in the Elements panel DOM tree. A reference
to this element is shown in the bottom left corner of the panel.

![The AI assistance panel with the context element highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/styling/conversation-context.png)

Change the context using the element picker next to the current element
or by selecting from the [Elements panel DOM tree](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/dom#inspect).

With the context selected, you can capture a screenshot of the viewport and submit it to your chat. Click the **Take screenshot** button next to the chat input field.

![The 'Take screenshot button' and an attached screenshot in the input field.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/take-screenshot.png)

You can use screenshots to provide additional visual context to your prompts, for example, to check if all visible buttons have the same spacing.

While the currently inspected element is the foundation of the conversation,
**AI assistance** has access to all web APIs to gather more information from the
inspected page. This includes querying other elements with
`document.querySelector` or evaluating computed styles.

## Prompting

When starting a new conversation, **AI assistance** for styling offers example
prompts to help you get started quickly.

![The AI assistance panel with the example prompts highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/styling/example-prompts.png)

Click any of the prompts to prefill the prompt input field at the bottom of the
panel.

Alternatively, type your own prompt or question into the input field.

To send a prompt, either press <kbd>Enter</kbd> or click the arrow on the right
side of the input field.

> [!TIP]
> **Tip:** Looking for inspiration on how to use **AI assistance** ? Check out [5 cool things to do with AI Assistance](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/5-cool-things-to-do-with-ai-assistance).

## Conversation flow

Sending a prompt starts the conversation with the styling agent. To get the
information required to answer your prompt best, the agent generates and
executes JavaScript that calls web APIs. Agent progress is shown in steps. The
initial step status is `Investigating...`.

![The AI assistance panel after a conversation started.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/styling/flow-investigating.png)

The step label updates as the agent executes more specific actions to solve your
question.

Once the agent comes to a final answer, the answer is displayed below the
investigation steps, including suggestions for follow-up prompts.

![The AI assistance panel with an answer given by AI.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/styling/flow-final.png)

Click any of the suggested prompts to continue the conversation. Click the

of an investigation step to get a better understanding of what AI assistance did
behind the scenes.

![The AI assistance panel with an expanded conversation step.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/styling/flow-step-expanded.png)

When you expand a progress chip, you see the code the agent has executed,
together with its return value. Copy the executed code for further use, like
executing it with the [Console panel](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/console).

> [!WARNING]
> **Experimental:** Generative code features are still experimental. See Google's policy on [Generative Code Assistance](https://support.google.com/legal/answer/13505487).

### Paused conversations

**AI assistance** might generate code with side effects. When that happens, the
conversation is paused before the code is executed.

![The AI assistance panel with a paused conversation.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/styling/flow-paused.png)

When the conversation pauses, review the code proposed by the agent. Click
**Continue** to proceed or **Cancel** to prevent execution.

> [!NOTE]
> **Note:** While the conversation is paused, prompt input is disabled.

### Save changes to your workspace

With a [connected workspace folder](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/workspaces), you can save style changes suggested by **AI assistance** back to CSS source files on your computer.

To do this:

1. First, [generate a metadata file](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/workspaces#generate-json) and [connect a workspace folder](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/workspaces#connect).

   Alternatively, you can [add a folder manually](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/workspaces#manual-connection).
2. Start a chat [from the Elements panel](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/styling#from_the_elements_panel).

3. Prompt **AI assistance** to modify your CSS.

4. **AI assistance** may generate code and [pause execution](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/styling#paused_conversations). Review the code and click **Continue** to test changes live.

5. Expand the **Unsaved changes** section and click **Apply to workspace**.

   > [!NOTE]
   > **Note:** If you don't have a connected workspace folder, at this step, the **AI assistance** panel will ask you to manually add it.

6. Review the changes in a `diff` and click **Save all**.

To learn this workflow, see:

### No answer given

**AI assistance** might not provide answers due to various reasons.

![The AI assistance panel with a refused conversation.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/answer-refused.png)

If you think your prompt is something **AI assistance** should be able to
discuss, [file a bug](https://goo.gle/devtools-bug).

### Conversation history

Once you start a conversation, every next answer is based on your previous
interactions between you and the AI.

AI assistance saves your conversation history between sessions, so you can access your previous chats even after DevTools or Chrome reload.

Use the controls in the top-left corner of the panel to control your conversation
history.

![The AI assistance panel with the history controls highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/history.png)

#### Start new

To start a new conversation with the currently selected
[conversation context](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/styling#conversation_context), click the button.

#### Continue

To continue a past conversation, click the button and select it from the context menu.

> [!NOTE]
> **Note:** [Conversation context](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/styling#conversation_context) is not automatically updated as it might have vanished since the conversation stopped.

#### Delete

To delete a conversation from history, click the button.

## Rate answers and provide feedback

**AI assistance** is an experimental feature. Therefore we are actively looking
for your feedback to learn how we can improve answer quality and the overall
experience.

![The AI assistance panel with rating controls highlighted.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/ai-assistance/images/rate-answers.png)

### Vote answers

Rate an answer using the
**Thumbs up** and
**Thumbs down** buttons below the answer.

### Report answers

To report inappropriate content, click the button next to the voting buttons.
